title: M8 exact minimum orbit-span predicate for semantic acceptance

spec.name: M8.OrbitSpan.spans_nonempty
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), c.1.Nonempty → c.2.Nonempty → (M8.OrbitSpan.spans c).Nonempty
spec.guidance:
Original M8 R_orb minimum, analysis-only. The runtime discovery does not calculate/store this Finset or receive a minimum-span oracle. Nonempty supports give arbitrary anchors with e=false,u=1, actual Anchor.anchored. Finset.min membership/min_le supplies attained/small iff, Anchor.passing_presentations equates the anchor and translation parameterizations. span_lt_order gives final bound. Preserve exact original nonempty domain and actual action. Tactic lines only.
import M8AnchorAccepted

namespace M8.OrbitSpan
/-- Analysis-only finite set, not materialized by the discovery algorithm. -/
noncomputable def spans {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun g : M7.Action.Record N => M8.Anchor.Anchored (M7.Action.act g c))).image
    (fun g => M8.Anchor.span (M7.Action.act g c))
noncomputable def value {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) : ℕ :=
  if h : (spans c).Nonempty then (spans c).min' h else 0
end M8.OrbitSpan
